This "Yes" comes with a MASSIVE asterisk. It's a lovingly crafted fine and noble addition to the justifiably lauded STALKER series of masterpieces. It comes with a hugely expanded Zone, intricate and engaging plot, solid and relatable characters, exquisitely detailed weapon system... and utterly frustrating, clunky, hair-tearingly impossible boss battles that completely contravene the tone of the game and make it damn nigh impossible to finish. I'm on the last battle of the game, but haven't beaten it yet because I'm not masochistic enough to spend a whole day dying OVER AND OVER AND OVER in the most pointless and frustrating way possible. If not for 4(ish) utterly unavoidable immersion breaking tone deaf slugfest slogfights, I'd give this one 10/10.

Deadly anomalies, dangerous mutants, anarchists and bandits... None will stop Duty on its triumphant march towards saving the planet!

The World fears The Zones expansion. Join Duty and save the innocent.

Stalker, protect the world from The Zone. Join Duty.

Heart of Chornobyl is the most polished the series has felt in terms of combat and exploration. Gunplay feels satisfying and the map is massive with both recognizable areas from the previous titles and some new ones, all without any loading screens. The only drawback to this is that the sprint system needs to be tweaked to reflect on the map size as I found myself chugging water/energy drinks so I can keep sprinting to another location.

The survival mechanics and difficulty gradually lose their relevance as you progress into the mid to late game. You start accumulating high end gear, stacks of medkits, and more ammunition than you know what to do with.

A questionable design choice is your starting pistol, weighing practically nothing and cannot be removed from your inventory, even when you get imprisoned by the Ward thus removing any the need to use other pistols.

Highly recommend, it has a great foundation, only held back by a few balancing and optimization issues.
Game is still in a shit state, world feels empty, A-life barely works, terrible optimization. Waiting for more patches.

Great first person survival horror game. Definitely worth the money.
The game has very slowly received support well after release, featuring fixes and free content. Excited for the DLC.
If you can look past the performance and sometimes bugs with npcs, then youve got one of the best open world, horror, survival games out now with great animations, combat, and gameplay.
Easily one of favorite series of all time. Great atmosphere, story and graphics. some small issues with "AI Life" but given the rest. Absolutely fantastic.

This game is a buggy nightmare. It has been since release and the creators have 0 intent on fixing game breaking bugs. The people that like this game are either lucky or just really willing to play this game over and over and over and over and over and over again because I have had entire playthrus ruined by bugs. Can't take it anymore and can't refund it so here's my warning.

Is good? Yes
Is fun? Yes
Is stalker? Yes
Is game run good? Bearable
Is crash? Not yet
Is stutter? Sometimes
Is gun shoot? Yes
Is loot lootable? Yes
Is enemy shootable? Yes
Is spicy air? Sometimes
Is take bullet to head? Don't remember

Wait for at least 10-15 patches until this game is actually at the level it should be on release...

the game is unfathomably broken in so so so so many many ways, ultimately making it unbearable to play even though I absolutely love the old games and would enjoy this one if it wasn't so fundamentally broken.
I'm posting this review right now because I simply can not progress the main plot due to the NPC I need to talk to refusing to speak with me after several game resets and reloads....

Edit: i was forced to download a mod for a console, then turn on noclip and that was legit the only way i could progress and finish the game, i started a new run 9-10 months after my last, about 5 patches have come since, and still... buggy, unoptimized, confusing and ultimately a pain. would not suggest unless you have an extremely beefy PC - it wont fix the game but at least make it bearable
With the latest patch they downgraded the graphics, the game now looks very cartoonish, before it was very realistic.
Amazing game GSC, thanks! ...I waited years for this game to come out. I have played the original trilogy many times from the discs and now own the Steam versions. Can't wait for the DLC content.

Stalker 2 is an amazing game that requires no knowledge of the previous installments to enjoy. Immerse yourself in this world of apocalypse and greed. Where everyone is out to loot your pockets and where the creatures of the zone want to feast on your corpse. Experience astounding story writing and phenomenal game play. Discover the ruins of the zone and the gear they hold as you balance relations between factions. Take care of your gear and maintain your weapons. Don't forget to sleep and eat and never venture into the night.
Amazing game. There is nothing currently out there that comes close to the immersion of this game. Highly recommend to anyone. AMAZING.

I am not an OG player, so I can't compare it to the original titles for better or worse. This game is good. It's a cool atmospheric walking simulator where the very air itself feels like it's trying to kill you, The gameplay loop is hearing rumors about a hidden stash, going there, and being killed by a flying orb of electric doom, and then realizing your last save was 20 minutes ago, so you do it all again. I can't say I love it, but I can't say I hate it either. It's like Cyberpunk and Dark Souls, open world with plenty to do (Cyberpunk), but the world doesn't want you there (Dark Souls).

There have been multiple patches since launch and sneaking is still 100% broken af. It's like the people who made this game never bothered playing the last three games in the series. If it's dark outside, my flashlight is off and I can barely make out enemies (or not even be able to discern them at all), I shouldn't be getting perforated like Swiss cheese. Here's hoping the game is fixed by the time it's worth buying a license to play it again.
pretty fun, story is not bad. takes a little time to get use to the world then everything is pretty simple.

Almost 300 hours of playtime and it's not worth buying in its current state: Unoptimized, buggy, crashes constantly, broken quests, broken difficulty balance, enemies have laser aim, guns have no balance, enemies don't spawn outside of 100 yards making long range weapons useless and countless other issues. Almost a year from release and patch 1.4 feels more like a beta than anything else. Game should not have been released as it was. Wait until GSC fixes the issues in another year to purchase so you can immerse yourself and enjoy the experience.

Great game and environment feels fantastic. Creatures can scare you sometimes...
The bad part is that the enemy AI could be better, and too many headshots to kill a regular enemy gets anoying. The real bad part are the crashes... but they are getting less frequent each patch. Still worth it!!!!!

Bought and played at launch as a long time stalker fan. This game's story is fantastic. But expect gameplay to be lack luster. No enemy damage effects. Mutants have egregiously large health pools to make up for their so so reveals. Random double bloodsucker encounters that stunlock you. And only finding bread, beer, and a few rounds of ammo on literally every corpse you come across. Everyone from the barely equipped bandit, to the tricked out ward soldiers carries nothing but bread, beer, and maybe 11 rounds for their current weapon MAX in their inventory. Nanite looks like garbage most of the time and UE5 is WAY undercooked in this application. Buy this only if you can overlook the fact that the devs MASSIVELY overpromised and underdeveloped the crap out of this game. Because even after several patches to fix the crashing mess they released, we still don't have any quality of life updates. (A Chimera shouldn't take 500 rounds and a Pseudogiant should have damage states and a limp after tanking 15 grenades)

Man, what a game. If you're a lover of the original trilogy this will be euphoria for you. The story is rich and woven with all sorts of intricacies and throwbacks to the original trilogy. The combat is challenging and the monsters are scary as all hell.
Sure, it's not without it's problems, but what is the zone without it's anomalies, stalker?

UPDATED REVIEW: this is still the #1 zone/post apocalyptic experience. its what started the genre, dark gritty. its worth the money, most of the negative reviews are from tourist hater cry babies. buy and enjoy it.

I know I completed & spent a lot of time on this game, but everything started to breakdown after the 2nd half of the main story. Only way I was able to proceed was to download console commands. Some quests were so absolutely broken because NPC's would be dead for no reason. Some quests were so broken, I had to initiate from console commands other quests of other factions in other to even proceed the game story. The game was so broken, and performance is abysmal. Why am I micro stuttering from 100 to 20 fps on a R5 5600 & RX 7900XT ? Buy this game next year when it works

Tough one. So I know this game came out half-baked but I thoroughly believe this game is actually really good now. Think about it this way: this team is based in the ukraine, lost one of their members (afaik) and still pumped out this banger. 

The performance still being iffy, this long after release, is a bit sad but there's mods for that. Speaking of - a gaming company that actively supports mods? That's rare, right?

All in all, this game has its kinks that are yet to be evened out, but it is still absolutely worth buying imho. See this game like a trusty ol' car that you love and genuinely care for, but you gotta tilt the gearshift a bit, pull the key upwards while igniting. It's got its problems, but is absolutely a good game!

A bit of background to me: I played "through" anomaly and gamma. great stuff! :)

Newest update completely bricked my game. Can't even launch it... Absolutely bonkers. Now I'm gonna have to restart from the beginning in a couple months when I care enough to try. I was really enjoying this game too....

This game is absurdly bloated, boring and overall just not worth the time i sunk in

I've put 50 hours into this game and I'm not even done with the main story even though its all i focused on, that's BS. The game-play and story is nowhere near as good to justify sinking anymore time into because its just the same cycle for all the missions, it feels like nothing is happening at all and when it does the game forgets about it 30 minutes later.

It's fallout 4, add realism and put it in eastern Europe and take out any interest you might have in the characters or story.

If they cut 10-20 hours from the main story, it would've been bearable but its too big for its own good to the point to tedium.

This game would be amazing if it worked, but it doesnt. I put this game down for over a year and let them continue to develop. I come back and on a new save Im still getting full game crashes at random. First one happened in the intro area. Completely unacceptable.
very good game. ending bugged but you can fix with command. anything but that is perfect
Good game. I hope they keep working on it, but as it is now it's still worth the money, I think.

Half-baked. This game should and could be incredible. But as it stands, I would not enjoy playing the full game. Contrary to popular opinion, performance issues are not what deters me from this game. Instead, the economy in this game is completely broken. You will end up using more resources on a simple mutant hunt mission than you get from the reward. Not to mention, repairing armor and weapons is ABSURDLY expensive. This completely ruins the experience of the game and makes questing not actually worth the trouble. 

I will happily amend my review when these issues are corrected. Until then, I can't recommend Stalker 2.

I just 100% the game and here are some key points I would like to say about it
- atmosphere is great nothing really beats being alone at night and its super dark in the zone
- the OST was pretty good when it came on, (fights or the endings)
- gun design was awesome and gun sound was top notch
things that I didn't like
-faction sided missions don't really hold any weight, they really don't matter towards the end
-Artifact bug needs to get fixed, it's not fun seeing the artifact you need or want get stuck or just fall through the map
-A life was interesting sometimes there would be all out battles in the zone and to find a bandit looted a bloodsucker was super cool really helps make the zone feel alive, or other times it would be spawning too many things or npcs would just pop up.

would I recommend this game? if you are planning to do one playthrough of this game sure, it's not a bad game but if you are planning to 100% the game I would hold off till GSC fixes the artifact bug or maybe just rework the entire system.

I wanna like it, I really do. But it's now almost 1 am and I've been playing for 4 hours now. I managed to get 500 meters before my game started crashing over and over again.
Made sure to check file integrity, updated my mods (7), but nothing. I just can't play. I wasted an evening...
By the way, I never had crash problems like this before.
I hope it's going to get better...but man, I wanna play it now. I don't wanna redo everything from the start without mods. Some things are needed to make the QoL better (and if I decide to take out the mods, I have to start a new save, since a couple of mods that I have cannot be deactivated in an ongoing playthrough)

I'm so disappointed in this game. It's horribly optimized for PC and completely unplayable in its current form. I played it on several gaming laptops that have high specs, using RTX 4000 and 5000 series GPUs, and tried every possible combination of settings, but it doesn't run smooth. I can overlook the low-grade graphics this game offers, but the massive drops in fps can't be ignored.
A bit janky and can't find settings that feel smooth and good consistently, but easily the best Stalker game without mods.
It still has some glitches and bugs... although the game seems ok, has a interesting story, but some times confusing... need some hours of playtime to understand the mechanics...

Gunplay is janky, AI either walks in a straight line or just stands still, performance is down the drain even with a 4080 super, visual artifacts everywhere, graphics look like 2015, character models look like they're from Gmod, I can go on and on. 

People are currently in the honeymoon phase, with hype and love for the franchise blinding them to the blatant flaws of the game. This needs at least a year of further development to be considered as "finished" 

If you like this game, that's completely fine. More power to you. But please stop lying and saying this game is GOTY material or anything remotely close to it.

I play exclusively on steam deck. The game runs sub 20fps unless you download the engine.ini from nexus mods. The decky frame Gen mod does not help and the dlss work around used to work but does not. Maybe I messed something up on the dlss work around but it's fine. Sometimes I have to exit the game and let the shaders recompile in order for the stuttering to subside but that's fine. Here's hoping the GSC optimizes for the deck in future updates.

Great game otherwise and highly recommend if you're a stalker fan

80% of the game is great. 20% - enemies that spawn behind your back and not fixed physics spiraling you out of cover. This game is immersive but once you are doing main story quests and "dungeons" - it's just really annoyingly bad. The fact that in cleared rooms that you went through there are spawning enemies that spawn behind your back - this fact alone - ruined the game for me at the end. Boss fights are anime-style and off-putting, enemies are sponges for bullets. Like, the whole world of that game, the adventure, exploration and no HUD gameplay is pristine and awesome, gunplay is the best, but oh my god some junior game designers ruined it with these boss fights and magically spawning enemies behind your back in tight corridors. If the sudden enemy spawn thing would be ever fixed - ill change my reivew to positive. Sad. I enjoyed the game, ending sequence of the game ruined it for me.
UPD: I've decided to change review to positive regardless. This is still an immersive and cool experience overall.

It's just not there yet. I can see the vision and this game has the potential to be something great; but it falls short on too many accounts. It's poor performance, endless bugs and issues, poor structure, poor story telling, unfair and broken knockdown cycles.

Cannot recommend in It's current state.

Got great hardware specs, am up to date - just crappy programming, and its you not us solutions to a problem lots of people seem to have. heres a clue, if lots of people have the problem its a developers issue not a users issue

and after finishing my 2nd game and starting the 3rd I decided to talk about stalker I don't want to summarize what stalker is like because it annoys me so I'll simply say: you walk for miles and miles full of stuff and 4 or 5 rifles of different types consuming non-stop drinks and in the meantime you find bandits and mutants shooting at you because this is stalker 2 brutal and fascinating if you like Soviet brutalism and the military attitude of eft it's for you even if it still has many flaws people who get stuck in the middle of the door, some bugged missions etc but one thing that I can't stand and will never stand is the protagonist's gun I understood the connection since that is the gun the protagonist used when he was in the army but the possibility of putting it in the trunk no right? that's why I don't buy guns etc for the rest it deserves a 9 out of 10 in my opinion

So good you guys - nothing quite like it although it draws immediate good vibes from Metro and Fallout.

So far a top experience and a wonder considering that Ukraine is at war and this game suffered delay and setback over and again - these devs delivered.

I love this game. They've been doing work to make it better since release and thats commendable.

If you like atmosphere, this game has got it. There's still things to work out in some areas but its a damn good game these days.
Fun but feels like a game from 10 years ago without being fixed with to many bugs. Wait until they fix the game or modders make it what it should be

wow, what a dull and boring game, it is devoid of any real story and is more a run around collector game. wasted some cash on the full edition too, my own fault.

would not advise playing this game for anyone that actually likes to immerse themselves in a game they play, stalker is just to linear for that.

Although I have a rather weak computer to play this game, I am happy to say that I have been waiting for this game for a very long time and I will definitely buy a new computer for this game. I'm a big fan of the past parts of the game, but the biggest fan of the game was my uncle, but unfortunately he couldn't see and play his favourite game because he died in the war against russia. It is very sad and painful for me to say this. I hope that in the future I will be able to play our favourite game and enjoy every detail, knowing that my uncle would have done the same. GSC, you are the best Ukrainian developers, even though there are some bugs, I'm sure you can fix them. Glory to Ukraine.
One of the best games ive ever played, it started out rough but my god its such a pleasure to play it.
The game would be great if it wasn't for all the bugs and performance issues. The most glaring ones are the crashes during shadder warmup and the extrems FPS drop when unique NPCs are on the screen.

I really do enjoy the atmosphere, but this game just runs so badly and enemies can spawn behind you as soon as you turn around. In the current state of this game it just destroys the atmosphere it creates. It's really a bummer.
i personally like the game. but god damn im so sick of devs relying on crappy ai tools for optimization

tldr.text: Mostly Positive (77%): players praise the story and characters.
The biggest complaint is bugs and crashes, mentioned in 37% of reviews.

details.text: Recent reviews complain less about bugs and crashes, at 23% against 37% across all time.
Players who have just started are far less positive than those who have logged many hours.
